# اِفْتَضَخْتُمْ (iftaḍaḵtum) /if.ta.dˤax.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اُفْتُضِخْتُمْ (uftuḍiḵtum) /uf.tu.dˤix.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
